title: Field Sampling of Root-Associated Microbes for DNA/RNA Extraction
author: Roey Angel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vd5e286

steps.title: Collect triplicate plant samples
steps.instruction: Select three individual plants spaced a few metres apart, ensuring each is a separate individual and not an off‑shoot of the same plant.

steps.title: Excavate plants with intact roots
steps.instruction: Using a garden trowel (Amazon), carefully dig out each plant while keeping the root system intact as much as possible.

steps.title: Remove loose soil from roots
steps.instruction: Hold the plant by the shoot and shake the root system vigorously enough to dislodge all loose soil, taking care to minimise damage. If large soil aggregates remain, remove them with a micro‑spatula (Carl Roth Catalog #AT16.1).

substeps.instruction: Shake roots to release loose soil.
Use micro‑spatula to pick off remaining aggregates.

steps.title: Trim representative root pieces
steps.instruction: From the remaining root system (including attached soil particles), trim a representative sample of roots using scissors or a scalpel (Scissors Carl Roth Catalog #HCT7.1) onto a piece of paper towel (Carl Roth Catalog #Y03.1).

steps.title: Cut roots to fit 2 ml tube
steps.instruction: Further cut the trimmed roots so that they will fit into a 2.0 ml microcentrifuge tube (Carl Roth Catalog #CK06.1).

steps.title: Weigh 2–3 g root‑soil mix into tube
steps.instruction: Place about 2–3 g of the cut root‑soil sample into a 2.0 ml tube using tweezers (Carl Roth Catalog #PX40.1). The root tissue should constitute at least half of the mass, with the remaining mass being attached soil.

steps.title: Compress sample and adjust volume
steps.instruction: Press the sample gently into the bottom of the tube with the micro‑spatula (Carl Roth Catalog #AT16.1) so that it occupies no more than 1/2–2/3 of the tube volume. If necessary, split the material into several tubes, each to be submerged later with LifeGuard solution.

steps.title: Add LifeGuard solution to submerge
steps.instruction: Add LifeGuard Soil Preservation Solution (Qiagen Catalog #12868-100) until the sample is covered by roughly twice its volume (approximately 1.0–1.5 ml). Dispense the solution with a disposable Pasteur pipette (Carl Roth Catalog #EA61.1).

steps.title: Cool samples to ~4 °C during transport
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a cooling box (Carl Roth Catalog #AA46.1) with cooling packs (Carl Roth Catalog #E447.1) to keep them at around 4 °C and maintain this temperature until reaching the laboratory.

steps.title: Store samples at –20 °C to –80 °C
steps.instruction: In the laboratory, store the cooled samples in a freezer at –20 °C to –80 °C (preferably –80 °C).
